docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Speedrunners is over a decade old and despite that there are not a lot of learning resources. With the dwindling playerbase the lack of opportunities to grow by playing people around your level have servely decreased this wiki serves to somewhat bridge that gap.

A lot of the information here was sourced from people in the discord and it's an invaluable source in learning more aobut the game.

If anyone wants to make a translated version of the wiki reach out to me on sky3d. I started setting up the wiki so that it could be easily translated but it became a hastle to get working so I'll only do it if there's some interest in it.

docs.title: A Listing of all the optimizations i can think of
docs.text:
• If you have tho touch the ground and you're above 600 speed you should slide. When walking you can only go max 600 speed so you'll slow down faster since more friction is applied when running vs sliding.

  • Maximize the height you fall from and take advantage of slope surfing to fall lower when possible. TODO Examples here.

  • You can buffer wall jumps. I think this one tends to be intuitive but it's good to put it into writing. TODO test jump efficiency at certain points. I think using advanced wall jump for the last jump is faster than two jumps unless you don't touch wall. If you don't touch wall the horizontal momentum you gain isn't a lot so you have to weigh.

    • things to test:
      • speed

  • Corners taking the path of least distance
